citations.assessment: The located unit gives R. Naḥman of Jaffa transmitting in the name of R. Yaakov of Caesarea. The Neḥemyah form in the adjoining dossier remains a separate reading.
The Menaḥma entry quotes a tradition in which this very Jaffa transmission follows another attributed saying.
The referred-to entry uses Neḥemyah for the same place and chain. Preserve the variant; neither locus authorizes a biographical merger.
